what: a naturalist's field notebook lying open on a flat grey rock in a forest, seen close from above at a slant: its covers are worn brown leather, and on its pale cream left page is one bold sketch in dark brown ink of a huge clawed monster footprint, four long toes with hooked claws; the right page is blank. A quill rests across the bottom of the book. Dappled daylight falls on the pages; the forest floor round the rock is dark green and brown.
colours: Worn brown leather covers; pale cream pages; a bold dark brown ink sketch of a clawed footprint; a brown quill; a grey rock; dark green and brown forest floor.
must_show: an open notebook
a sketch of a big clawed footprint on one page
pale pages against a dark forest floor

what: a hunter's trophy on a dark stone wall, seen close: a great horned monster skull of pale bone, with long curving horns and a jaw of big fangs, mounted on a shield-shaped plaque of dark oak; crossed beneath it hang a long hunting spear with a bright silver blade and a silver-bladed hunting knife. Warm torchlight from the upper left lights the pale skull and the silver blades bright against the dark wall.
colours: A pale bone skull with darker bone-brown shading; dark oak plaque; bright silver blades; dark wooden spear shaft; a dark grey stone wall.
must_show: one great horned monster skull mounted on a plaque
crossed silver spear and knife below it
pale skull against a dark wall

what: a hunter-scholar's hall of trophies, seen close: on a dark stone wall, five monster skulls of pale bone are mounted in an arch, each on its own dark oak plaque: in the middle and highest, the largest, a dragon's skull with long swept-back horns; on its left a wolf's long narrow skull and a bull's skull with wide horns; on its right a serpent's flat wedge-shaped skull and a goblin's small skull with two tusks. Below them, on a stand, lies a huge ancient book bound in black scaled leather with gold corners, closed. A violet and gold light falls from above; the wall is dark.
colours: Pale bone skulls with bone-brown shading; dark oak plaques; a book of black scaled leather with gold corners; violet and gold light; a dark grey stone wall.
must_show: five different monster skulls mounted in an arch
a dragon skull largest in the middle
a great closed book below

what: a great serpent biting its own tail, forming one perfect round circle that fills the picture: its head is at the top, its jaws closed on the tip of its own tail, its long body curving down round both sides and meeting again at the top. Its scales are dark green with a broad stripe of bright gold down its back, its belly pale cream, its eye a small gold spark. Behind it, a dark background with a soft gold glow in the middle of the circle.
colours: Dark green scales with a bright gold stripe and pale cream belly plates; a gold eye; a dark background with a soft gold glow in the middle.
must_show: one serpent forming a circle
its head biting its own tail
a gold glow inside the circle

what: a thick old leather-bound book lying closed on a dark wooden desk, seen close and a little from above; its dark green leather cover bears one large gold silhouette of a dragon, stamped in the middle, and it is fastened by a clasp made from a monster's curved black claw. colours: Dark emerald-green leather; a bright gold dragon silhouette and gold corners; a black curved claw clasp; pale cream page edges; a dark wooden desk; deep brown shadow.
must_show: a thick closed book
a gold dragon emblem on its cover
a claw clasp

what: a huge ancient bestiary lying wide open on a carved wooden stand, seen close and from the front: on its left page a painted picture in rich colours of a red dragon, on its right page a painted picture of a gold griffin, both pictures glowing softly; there is no writing anywhere on the pages. The book's covers are dark green leather with gold corners. Warm candlelight from both sides makes the pale pages glow against the deep brown shadow round it.
colours: Pale cream pages with a painted red dragon and a painted gold griffin; dark green leather covers with gold corners; a dark carved wooden stand; deep brown shadow.
must_show: a huge open book
painted pictures of a dragon and a griffin on its pages
glowing pages against dark
